title: Basis of the Circle Membership Relief against a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Restocking Fee
content:
The relief the membership gives against a restocking fee is the tier's published restocking fee waiver share of the fee still standing against the return, and the relief never exceeds the fee still standing. Where the schedule waives the fee for a Circle member outright, the whole fee still standing is relieved and no share is worked out. The fee still standing against the return is what has been charged against it less what has already been relieved, and is never less than nothing. The relief is recorded with the membership as its ground. The relief is rounded to the cent.

## The two quantities

**The fee still standing** against a Northbeam Returns and Restocking return is what has been charged against it less what has already been relieved. It is never less than nothing, so a return on which more has been relieved than was ever charged has a fee still standing of nothing.

**The relief** is the share taken on the fee still standing. Holding it to the fee still standing and rounding it to the cent are taken last of all, so the relief never exceeds the fee still standing. Where the schedule waives the fee for a Circle member outright, the whole fee still standing is relieved and no share is worked out at all.

| The schedule the line falls under | The relief |
| --- | --- |
| waives the fee for a Circle member outright | the whole of the fee still standing |
| does not | the tier's published restocking fee waiver share of the fee still standing, and never more than that fee |

## Worked through on hypothetical inputs

*A return on a schedule that does not waive a Circle member's fee outright, 60.00 USD charged against it and nothing relieved so far, the tier publishing a restocking fee waiver share of 30 per cent.* The fee still standing is 60.00 USD; 30 per cent of that is 18.00 USD; the relief is 18.00 USD.

*The same return, 20.00 USD already relieved against it.* The fee still standing is 60.00 USD less 20.00 USD, that is 40.00 USD; 30 per cent of that is 12.00 USD; the relief is 12.00 USD.

*The same return, the tier publishing a waiver share of 150 per cent.* One hundred and fifty per cent of 60.00 USD is 90.00 USD, but the relief never exceeds the fee still standing, so the relief is 60.00 USD.

*A return on a schedule that does waive a Circle member's fee outright, 60.00 USD charged and nothing relieved.* The whole fee still standing is relieved, that is 60.00 USD, and no share is worked out.

*A return with 40.00 USD charged and 55.00 USD already relieved.* The fee still standing is never less than nothing, so it is nothing, and the relief is 0.00 USD.

## The ground recorded

The relief is recorded with the membership as its ground.
